scripts.setup: cd apps/backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../desktop && npm install
scripts.test: cd apps/backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m unittest && cd ../desktop && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.package: cd apps/backend && .venv\Scripts\pyinstaller backend.spec --noconfirm && cd ../desktop && npm run package
